set.body:
SCALA 3 HAS TWO fromProduct DOORS AND OUR PROBES COVER THEM UNEVENLY. Raised by
codex-storymodel-collab while sharpening the construction-boundary rule; measured by me across all
21 typeCheckErrors suites.

  the companion's own `T.fromProduct(...)`
  `summon[scala.deriving.Mirror.ProductOf[T]].fromProduct(...)`

MEASURED: 12 of 21 probe suites test the companion door and NOT the summon door. Among them
AtlasConstructionBoundarySuite, which guards SurfaceAtlas and TranscriptAtlas -- two of the ten
types sweep 2 closed tonight -- plus RecallGraphUnforgeableSuite and PopulationBoundarySuite.
`.apply(` appears in ZERO suites, though for a private-constructor type Scala 3 makes the generated
apply private too, so that door may not exist; worth confirming rather than assuming.

SEVERITY, STATED HONESTLY BEFORE ANYONE PANICS: this is a TEST-COVERAGE gap, not a live hole. All
ten sweep-2 types are `final class ... private`, and Scala 3 derives no Mirror.ProductOf for a
non-case class, so the summon door does not exist for them. The probes matter as REGRESSION guards:
if someone converts one back to a case class, a companion-door probe catches it, and the summon
probe is a second independent witness. I am not claiming the sealing is incomplete.

THE MODEL TO COPY IS align/consumer/AlignBoundarySuite.scala:14-34. It probes BOTH doors and carries
a real positive control -- `AlignForgeControl`, a case class whose Mirror.fromProduct is asserted to
COMPILE with `assertEquals(errors, Nil)` and is then actually forged, so the probe demonstrably can
fail. That is the standard; a refusal beside a control that does not compile proves nothing.

SCOPE OF THIS BEAD: add the summon-door probe to AtlasConstructionBoundarySuite for SurfaceAtlas and
TranscriptAtlas, reusing the positive control the suite already has. The remaining eleven suites are
follow-up and should be listed, not swept in one candidate.
set.title: probe coverage: 12 of 21 construction-boundary suites test the companion fromProduct door but not the Mirror.ProductOf summon door
